summary: Tomorrow's July CPI report is the week's defining event, arriving as markets price roughly two-thirds odds of a Fed rate hike in September under Chair Warsh, who has abandoned forward guidance. A dollar stuck below its 30-day moving average — pressured by tariff uncertainty and shifting rate expectations — is amplifying gold's outperformance while keeping bond duration under pressure from elevated real rates.
